purpose: Qualify the application's JMLE PCM parameterization against FACETS before extending any additive-RSM compatibility claim to PCM or multiple scales.

model_contract.application: Adjacent-category PCM with one threshold vector per selected step-facet level; each vector is identified by an exact sum-to-zero constraint.
model_contract.facets: Models=?,?,?,#,R3 for Person, Rater, Task, Criterion, with Criterion as the partial-credit facet.
model_contract.initial_scope: One shared category support with criterion-specific threshold vectors; no named-scale recoding and no mixed category counts.

stages.name: syntax_and_parser_probe
stages.data: One immutable balanced pilot run, fitted as PCM even though generated under RSM.
stages.claim_limit: FACETS syntax, Table 8 multi-table mapping, score parsing, and obvious sign/centering faults only.

stages.name: known_truth_pcm_smoke
stages.data: Independent Python PCM generator with deliberately heterogeneous criterion threshold vectors and paired seeds.
stages.claim_limit: Implementation matching and truth-recovery direction only; not operating characteristics.

stages.name: pcm_pipeline_pilot
stages.claim_limit: Runtime, convergence, missing/unmeasurable accounting, and tolerance stability; not confirmatory estimator performance.

direct_comparison_gates.input_identity: FACETS and Python consume the same retained rating rows and category support.
direct_comparison_gates.facets_return_and_parse: Exit code zero, convergence criterion met, all expected Table 8 scale tables mapped one-to-one to step-facet levels.
direct_comparison_gates.structural_identifiability: Direct comparison requires nullity zero for the expanded PCM eta/threshold design.
direct_comparison_gates.category_counts: Every FACETS Table 8 scale/category Total count must equal an independently recomputed count for that step-facet level.

rounding_contract.primary_pass: Umean=0,1,6 remains authoritative for measures and thresholds.
rounding_contract.auxiliary_pass: Umean=0,1,2 supplies category Outfit only when the six-decimal fixed-width token is truncated.
rounding_contract.raw_parity_prohibited: Displayed category Outfit and fit values are not treated as raw FACETS statistics.

negative_controls: Fit the RSM-generated syntax probe as PCM; do not call its threshold heterogeneity known truth.
Retain nonconvergence, structural nonidentification, missing scale tables, and unmapped tables as explicit failures.
Include at least one deliberately near-RSM PCM threshold condition in the known-truth smoke.
prohibited_claims: Do not label all application PCM workflows FACETS-matched from the syntax probe.
Do not generalize to named General/Specific scales, mixed category supports, recoding, anchored thresholds, or more than one # facet.
Do not infer estimator bias, coverage, false-positive rate, or power from the smoke stages.
Do not change tolerances after seeing FACETS-Python differences; disclose any failure and amend prospectively.
